title: Ello Oasis 40 oz Tumbler — Pink Gingham

comparisons.notes: 40 oz Pink Gingham selected; active sale price, available to add to cart.

writeup: The Oasis pairs a handle with a retractable straw, a practical combination for carrying a large cold drink. This offer is for the 40-ounce Pink Gingham version, which Ello listed at an already-discounted $31.44 during our check. At $9.99, Woot undercuts that sale price by 68%, without relying on the higher regular price.
notes: New; Woot lists a 90-day warranty. Shipping is excluded from this comparison; Ello’s free-shipping threshold was $75 when checked.
